article.headline: Ty Francis scores 17 to lead Le Moyne to 68-58 victory over D-II's Mansfield
article.description: — Ty Francis’ 17 points helped Le Moyne defeat Division II's Mansfield 68-58 on Monday.
article.linkText: Ty Francis scores 17 to lead Le Moyne to 68-58 victory over D-II's Mansfield
article.story: SYRACUSE, N.Y. -- — Ty Francis’ 17 points helped Le Moyne defeat Division II's Mansfield 68-58 on Monday. Francis added five rebounds for the Dolphins (3-4). Trevor Roe scored 10 points while going 3 of 7 (2 for 5 from 3-point range). Leandro Gysel went 4 of 12 from the field (1 for 6 from 3-point range) to finish with nine points. Jackson Henry finished with 11 points for the Mountaineers. Naeem Richardson added 10 points and Ty Barrett finished with nine points. Up next: Le Moyne plays Friday against Maine, and Mansfield visits Niagara on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
